permissions.name: products:read
permissions.description: See draft and archived products, stock levels and purchases in the admin

permissions.name: products:update
permissions.description: Edit products, including their price, options and stock

permissions.name: products:types:manage
permissions.description: Create, edit and delete product types and the custom fields they have

permissions.name: products:purchases:record
permissions.description: Record a purchase made elsewhere, and reverse one

settings.name: currency
settings.description: The three-letter currency code prices are shown in, e.g. usd, eur, gbp

settings.name: prices_visible
settings.description: Show prices to visitors. Turn off to run a catalog that never shows what things cost

settings.name: page_size
settings.description: How many products the public product list shows per page

groups.name: kempo-products:viewer
groups.description: Can see everything in the catalog, including drafts, but not change it

groups.name: kempo-products:manager
groups.description: Can add, edit and delete products and record purchases

groups.name: kempo-products:admin
groups.description: Can manage products, and set up the product types and fields they have
